stories.headline: Google just shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash with 2M token context
stories.blurb: DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, a faster model that can process up to 2 million tokens of context — enough for entire codebases, long documents, or hours of video. It's available now in AI Studio and the Gemini API, with better speed and lower cost than the previous Flash model.
stories.why_it_matters: You can now feed an entire codebase or documentation set into a single prompt without chunking.

stories.headline: xAI just shipped agents that run 24/7 on their own computers
stories.blurb: Grok Bot gives you a team of AI agents that each get their own computer environment. They can work inside actual tools and apps the way a person would, and they keep running around the clock even when you're offline.
stories.why_it_matters: First major AI lab to ship persistent agents with dedicated compute that work like remote employees.

stories.headline: Google's AI now translates sign language straight to text on your phone
stories.blurb: DeepMind released SL2T, a model that converts American Sign Language to text in real time using your phone's camera. It's rolling out in beta for Android and iOS, letting Deaf and hard-of-hearing users text, search, and communicate without typing. The model runs on-device, so it works offline and keeps signing private.
stories.why_it_matters: First mainstream sign language AI that actually ships to consumers, not just a research demo.
stories.original_headline: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands

stories.headline: Suno just added MIDI and turned into a real music editor
stories.blurb: Suno's Studio 2.0 now supports MIDI files, custom audio effects, and a chatbot that tweaks your tracks on command. You can import MIDI, apply reverb or distortion with natural language, and edit AI-generated music like you would in a DAW. It's no longer just a prompt-to-song generator.
stories.why_it_matters: AI music tools are crossing into serious production software territory.
stories.original_headline: Suno is trying to look more like a real music production tool

stories.headline: Databricks raises $5B at $190B valuation after investors begged to pile in
stories.blurb: The data and AI platform wanted $1 billion. Investors wanted to write checks for $15 billion. Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi settled on $5 billion because, as he told TechCrunch, running AI infrastructure is expensive and the demand was there. The round values the company at $190 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: Enterprise AI companies can now raise whatever they want — the money is chasing them.
stories.original_headline: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.

stories.headline: Apple built a custom AI model for China with Alibaba's help
stories.blurb: Apple trained a China-specific large language model in partnership with Alibaba, according to Reuters. The collaboration marks a rare cross-border AI partnership as U.S.-China tech tensions escalate, and suggests Apple is creating region-specific AI infrastructure rather than deploying a single global model.
stories.why_it_matters: Apple is localizing AI by geography, not just language — a strategy that could reshape how global tech companies build for regulated markets.
stories.original_headline: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba

try_this_prompt.title: The strategy stress test
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'll describe our current strategy below. Your job: play the smart competitor who just raised serious money and is coming after us. Tell me the three moves you'd make to exploit our weaknesses, then flip it and tell me the one thing we're doing that you'd actually be worried about.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: When your roadmap needs an adversarial review before you commit the quarter.
